_note: Pairs for validating temporal-aware contradiction resolution: an NLI-flagged disagreement between two claims should only be a genuine contradiction (is_true_contradiction=true) when both claims describe the same point/window in time (their extracted event dates are Allen-coincident). If the dates are sequential (before/after/meets/met_by -- a lifecycle transition like proposed->signed->rejected), the disagreement is claim evolution, not contradiction, even though a naive NLI-only check would flag it. This is the ablation for src/credibility/corroboration.py's temporal_gate: naive NLI-only vs. NLI+Allen-relation-gated. See evaluate_temporal_contradiction.py. eq_00X/contra_00X/neutral_00X (10 items) use point dates only (date_a == end_a implicitly); interval_00X (2 items) add real start != end intervals (end_a/end_b fields) specifically to differentiate full Allen-relation reasoning from a coarse same-day/week/month distance-bucket baseline (src/temporal/time_bucket_gate.py) -- point-only pairs can't expose that gap, since a coarse bucket and an exact point relation agree on every point-only case.

items.sentence_a: The China-Romania energy deal was proposed during talks in Bucharest.
items.sentence_b: The China-Romania energy deal was signed by both governments.
items.reason: sequential lifecycle stages (proposed -> signed), not a contradiction

items.sentence_a: Trade agreement negotiations opened this week in Beijing.
items.sentence_b: The trade agreement was rejected by the Romanian parliament.
items.reason: sequential lifecycle stages (opened -> rejected), not a contradiction

items.sentence_a: The meeting between the two delegations was scheduled for June 1.
items.sentence_b: The meeting between the two delegations was cancelled.
items.reason: scheduled, then later cancelled -- sequential, not contradictory

items.sentence_a: Construction on the battery plant began in March.
items.sentence_b: The battery plant project was suspended.
items.reason: began, then later suspended -- sequential, not contradictory

items.sentence_a: Twelve people were injured in the June 1 drone strike.
items.sentence_b: Only two people were injured in the June 1 drone strike.
items.reason: same incident, same date, conflicting casualty counts

items.sentence_a: Romania and China signed the energy deal on June 1.
items.sentence_b: Talks on the energy deal collapsed on June 1 without an agreement.
items.reason: same date, mutually exclusive outcomes for the same negotiation

items.sentence_a: The summit held on June 1 saw high turnout.
items.sentence_b: The summit held on June 1 saw low turnout.
items.reason: same summit, same date, conflicting turnout description

items.sentence_a: Officials confirmed the June 1 drone entered Romanian airspace.
items.sentence_b: Officials denied the June 1 drone entered Romanian airspace.
items.reason: same date, confirmed vs. denied the same factual claim

items.sentence_a: China's Permanent Representative to the United Nations Fu Cong spoke at the Security Council's emergency meeting on June 1.
items.sentence_b: Fu Cong, China's UN envoy, addressed the Security Council during an emergency session held on June 1.
items.reason: paraphrase, not a disagreement at all

items.sentence_a: In addition, high energy prices in Europe create real opportunities for new technologies, including energy storage.
items.sentence_b: Romania's parliament debated an unrelated agricultural subsidy bill on Tuesday.
items.reason: unrelated topics, not a disagreement -- sanity-check negative

items.sentence_a: The trade agreement was in effect from March 1 to June 30, 2025.
items.sentence_b: The trade agreement was suspended on April 15, 2025.
items.reason: Allen differentiation case: April 15 falls INSIDE the March-June validity interval (Allen relation 'contains', temporally coincident), so 'in effect' vs 'suspended' is a real contradiction about the same window -- but a coarse distance bucket anchored on the interval's start date (March 1) sees April 15 as ~45 days away and would wrongly reclassify this as evolution. This is the case point-only pairs (eq_00X/contra_00X above) cannot expose.

items.sentence_a: The pilot program ran from January 1 to March 31, 2025.
items.sentence_b: A new expanded program launched in September 2025.
items.reason: Allen 'before' relation (the two intervals don't overlap at all) -- legitimate sequential evolution, both the Allen gate and a coarse distance bucket should agree here (included as a fair companion case, not just ones rigged to favor the interval-aware method).
